class: Any panel that is drawn only when its data read succeeds: a slow or failed read removes the panel with no message, so the user cannot tell absent from broken.
mechanism: The plan card was conditional on the plan response; a request over its time limit left it empty.

first_seen.where: plan card on 8 practice trades (GC-ICFIX issue 2)
first_seen.evidence: The card vanished on 4 of 8 practice trades when the plan request took 12-18 s against a 10 s limit.

fix: One shared could-not-load state with a Retry; the plan read alone has a 30 s limit.

detection.note: Unguarded: no named check is confirmed to cover the class; the proof was one real run, not a standing check. Pixels not proven (no screen proof yet).

occurrences.evidence: The card vanished on 4 of 8 practice trades when the plan request took 12-18 s against a 10 s limit.
